about_the_game:
Bonk It! Demo: Take Your First Step to the Top!

Join the climbing chaos with the free Bonk It! demo! Trapped inside a cauldron, use only a hammer to overcome obstacles and reach the top. But remember, this is just the beginning!

What’s Included in This Demo?

  • A fun and challenging climb from a small section of the full game! Learn from your falls and push yourself higher each time.

  • Play solo or with friends! The demo includes multiplayer support for up to 6 players.

  • Customize your look! Try out a few cauldron, hammer, and hat options.

  • Physics-based gameplay! Your skills and strategy will determine how far you can go.

What’s in the Full Game?

  • A World Full of Mystery! Uncharted landscapes, strange environments, and surprises waiting to be discovered! The path to the top is never predictable.

  • Every Step is a New Challenge! More complex obstacles, unexpected traps, and physics-based mechanics that make every climb unforgettable.

  • More Customization! The full version offers hundreds of cauldrons, hammers, and hats!

  • Race to the Top! Work together or leave your friends behind—but be careful, the road to the summit is never as simple as it seems.

Take your first step with the demo, but the real adventure awaits in the full version!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen R5 1600 processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 processor
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT

short_description: Bonk It!: Reaching the Summit Has Never Been This Fun! Find yourself trapped inside a cauldron, armed only with a hammer, as you attempt to overcome the obstacles in your path! Offering a fun yet challenging climbing adventure, Bonk It! can be played solo or with friends.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Russian, Turkish
